newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg buys majority in Brazil's PAV.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg buys majority in Brazil's PAV.

text.p: Swedish metals and rubber group Trelleborg said on Wednesday its rubber unit Trelleborg Industrier bought a majority stake in Brazilian rubber company Projetos e Aplicacoes de Vibrotecnica e Vedacao Ltda (PAV).

"The acquisition is part of the globalisation of our manufacturing of components for the vehicle industry," said Mikael Jonson, head of the business area Automotive & Composite Material within Trelleborg Industrier, in a statement.
Remaining shares are held by the PAV's founder Nelson Pacheco da Fonseca who will stay on as president.
PAV has annual sales of 55 million crowns and 110 employees at its plants in Sao Paulo.
